title: needlepoint christmas stocking
text: needlepoint christmas stocking. Very lovely, heirloom quality stocking. Very expensive - but they look expensive in person too.  Will last a very long time.  It's so nice NOT to fight the "yarn strings" of the old knitted stockings we had.  Sooooo hard to fill.  These are nicely lined and very easy to fill.  Measurements given were accurate.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
